description.value: Silver House Restaurant is a family-owned Chinese restaurant on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge, in continuous operation since 1999. It has been voted Best Chinese Food in Ridge Meadows six times between 2009 and 2017. The restaurant offers dine-in, pickup with a discount, and local delivery, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Maple Ridge town corridor.
